name: Light Domain

source.note: PHB-only subclass entered from knowledge; check against the book.

summary: Wields radiance and fire: Radiance of the Dawn scorches foes, Warding Flare spoils attacks.

feature.name: Light Domain Spells
feature.summary: Always prepared: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray, See Invisibility; more at 5, 7 and 9.
feature.text: Your domain keeps these spells prepared for you: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire, Scorching Ray and See Invisibility at Cleric level 3, Daylight and Fireball at 5, Arcane Eye and Wall of Fire at 7, Flame Strike and Scrying at 9.

feature.name: Radiance of the Dawn
feature.summary: Channel Divinity: dispel magical Darkness within 30 feet; foes take 2d10 + Cleric level Radiant (Con save halves).
feature.text: As a Magic action, spend a Channel Divinity use: magical Darkness within 30 feet is dispelled, and each creature of your choice in that area makes a Constitution save, taking 2d10 + your Cleric level Radiant damage on a failure or half on a success.

feature.name: Warding Flare
feature.summary: Reaction: impose Disadvantage on an attack roll within 30 feet; uses = Wis modifier per Long Rest.
feature.text: When a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, you can take a Reaction to impose Disadvantage on it. You can do this a number of times equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum once); all uses return on a Long Rest.

feature.name: Improved Warding Flare
feature.summary: Warding Flare returns on a Short Rest and grants 2d6 + Wis Temporary Hit Points.
feature.text: You regain every use of Warding Flare when you finish a Short or Long Rest. And whenever you use it, the creature the attack was aimed at gains Temporary Hit Points equal to 2d6 + your Wisdom modifier.

feature.name: Corona of Light
feature.summary: Shed 60 feet of sunlight for a minute; foes in it have Disadvantage on saves against your fire and radiance.
